title: Sample Complexity of Equivariant Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2609.36421v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) is a powerful framework for robotic control, yet its practical application is often hindered by high sample complexity. This is particularly restrictive in physical domains where interaction data is costly. While the world often exhibits geometric and physical symmetries, standard RL algorithms typically fail to exploit this structure. In this paper, we demonstrate that exploiting group symmetries significantly reduces the sample complexity of RL. Focusing on finite-horizon Markov decision processes, we find that leveraging homomorphisms induced by group symmetries significantly reduces the theoretical upper and lower bounds on the number of environment interactions required to reach an optimal return. We further extend these bounds to continuous state and action spaces, providing corresponding sample-complexity guarantees under appropriate regularity assumptions. translated_title: 等变强化学习的样本复杂度
translated_abstract: 强化学习（RL）是机器人控制的一个强大框架，但其实际应用常常受到高样本复杂度的阻碍。这在交互数据代价高昂的物理领域中限制尤为明显。尽管现实世界通常表现出几何和物理对称性，但标准的RL算法通常未能利用这种结构。在本文中，我们证明利用群对称性可以显著降低强化学习的样本复杂度。聚焦于有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，我们发现利用由群对称性诱导的同态映射能够显著降低达到最优回报所需环境交互次数的理论上界和下界。我们进一步将这些界扩展到连续状态和动作空间，在适当的正则性假设下提供了相应的样本复杂度保证。除理论之外，我们还通过实验验证了我们的发现……
tldr: 本文证明利用群对称性诱导的同态结构可显著降低强化学习的样本复杂度，并为有限时域MDP及连续状态动作空间下所需环境交互次数提供了更紧的理论上下界保证。
